The refinery's fuels burn in the Fuel Burner, the Firebox Array and the Gas Turbine Array:
| Fuel | HU/mB | Burns at |
| Gasoline | 450 | 1,250°C |
| Diesel | 420 | 1,150°C |
| Kerosene | 380 | 1,150°C |
| Refinery Gas (a gas) | 300 | 1,200°C |
All four burn 0.5 mB/t in the Fuel Burner. Their values are in config (power.burners.refineryFuels).

# Diesel Generator
The Diesel Generator burns Diesel, Gasoline, Biodiesel or Refinery Gas straight to FE (see Diesel Generator).
# Jetpack
Kerosene fuels the Jetpack: 0.18 thrust for 2 mB/t, a long burn. Click a Kerosene Canister or bucket onto it in your inventory.
# Where they come from
- Gasoline: the Catalytic Reformer, from Naphtha.
- Diesel: the Distillation Array and the Cracking Unit.
- Kerosene: the Distillation Array, 10 or more tall.
- Refinery Gas: the Distillation Array, the Cracking Unit and the Coker.
